data.name: HowlOWeen Harvest Family Festival
data.headline: Jump into the spirit of the season with hands-on animal encounters, crafts, games, and family-friendly fun!
data.description: Enjoy a family skele-fun celebration at the Howl-O-Ween Harvest Family Festival on the Humane Education Campus. Kids and adults can meet animal ambassadors in themed attire, visit trick-or-treat and craft stations, try face painting, explore a mini pumpkin patch, and test their courage in mildly haunted rooms. The event mixes hands-on animal encounters with music, games and seasonal activities to create a playful, spooky atmosphere for toddlers through elementary ages.

highlight_box.title: A fun fall festival for the whole family!
highlight_box.description: Animal encounters, costumes, crafts, activities, playground access, face painting, mini pumpkins, and trick-or-treat stations. Perfect for toddlers through elementary-aged children and their families.

data.highlights:
* Hands-on animal encounters with ambassadors in festive attire
* Trick-or-treat and craft stations for children
* Mildly haunted rooms suitable for young audiences
* Face painting, games and seasonal music throughout the event
data.itinerary: Event starts at 9am and ends at 1pm. We advise giving yourself at least 1-2 hours to enjoy all the activities available. You do the activities in whatever order suits you best!

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067
meeting_point.instructions:
Below are specific parking directions as our location has two different entrances that do not connect to one another. Parking areas are listed in order of preference for use. Please check in at the lobby at the front of the Humane Education Campus.

[View Directions to Humane Education Campus 2025.pdf](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aWMtjyilbGYr79GrYegKrJ5LAC-ZR6wk/view?usp=sharing)

**Note:** Helen Woodward Way is NOT accessible via El Apajo; you must enter from San Dieguito Road. It is closed via El Apajo by a traffic gate only the fire department can operate that isn’t visible on GPS and Google maps.

The speed limit on Helen Woodward Animal Center grounds is 5mph and this is strictly enforced.

**1. Humane Education Campus (PURPLE on the map, 1st choice):** [View GPS link to Humane Education Campus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eM9kaXE1rUa1KM1R7)
Turn onto Helen Woodward Way off San Dieguito Road. Follow Helen Woodward Way straight, and continue straight after the stop sign. After parking, walk to the front of the Humane Education Campus directly next to the parking lot. Enter on the further side of the lot (by El Apajo Road) and exit at the closer side (by the lobby). Staff will approach your vehicle before exiting to sign in/out the participant(s) and get them out of the vehicle and safely escorted to the program.

**2. Overflow parking (BLUE on the map, 2nd choice):** [View GPS link to Lot B](https://maps.app.goo.gl/b6e5a7EqAgWcPC4z5)
This is additional parking if you or your guests need more space. Turn onto Helen Woodward Way off San Dieguito Road. Follow Helen Woodward Way straight and then turn left at the stop sign. Beyond the automatic white gate there is parking around the white-fenced horse arena. You can continue on the road until the end and turn left, and at the end of that road is a dirt lot by another horse arena. After parking, walk back towards the Helen Woodward Way Road. There’s a dirt path beside the building that you walk down to get to the front of the Humane Education Campus.
- **Please do not park in spots labeled “Reserved”.**
- **Weekends only:** you can also park in the spots labeled “Visitor” before the automatic white gate.

- Right turn on San Dieguito Rd. – 3.2 miles
- **Humane Education Campus & Overflow:** Left turn on Helen Woodward Way (just before El Apajo Rd.).

**I-5 Southbound (coming from the North – Oceanside, Encinitas)**

**1-15 Northbound (coming from the South – Poway, Rancho Bernardo, and Scripps Ranch)**

- Right turn on Camino Del Sur exit 6
- Continue on Camino Del Sur – 3.3 miles
- Left turn on San Dieguito Rd. – 2.6 miles
- **Humane Education Campus & Overflow:** Right turn on Helen Woodward Way (just after El Apajo Rd.).

**I-15 Southbound (coming from the North – Temecula, Riverside, Escondido)**

data.cancellation_notes:
We operate rain or shine.

Canceling 48 hours prior: Will receive a refund of 95% of the paid value

Canceling or rescheduling less than 48 hours prior: Will result in no refund.

Rescheduling 48 hours prior will result in transferring your registration to the new date and time without a charge.
data.booking_notes: Thank you for registering for Howl-O-Ween Harvest Family Days at Helen Woodward Animal Center! Our animal friends are excited to celebrate the autumn season with your family, don't forget to bring your camera and please wear close toed shoes.
data.check_in_details:
* Please enter the gate to the side of the lobby, there will be signs helping direct you to the registration booth. We will scan the QR codes of the tickets sent to you in your confirmation email.
* Tickets can be purchased ahead of time or at any point morning of and during the event, but all purchasing and registration is done online through the software.
* We will give you a red wrist band if you did not agree to the media policy.
data.pricing:
Pricing is set per child and adult, so total costs vary based on final group size.
* Infants and children in strollers who are not participating in festival activities are admitted for free.

When booking, do you best estimation of child and adult head count. Day of, we will do a final head count and settle total costs.
data.special_requirements:
* Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
* Children must be accompanied by an adult. Must book at least one adult to proceed with booking children.
data.restrictions:
* **Shoes**: For safety reasons, closed-toed shoes only. No sandals allowed.
* **Drawstrings**: For safety reasons, drawstrings (hoodies, pants or shorts) should not be worn on the playground.
* **Pets**: No pets are allowed on the campgrounds. There are no exceptions to this safety policy. Cannot leave pets alone in vehicles.
* **Toys, books, stuffed animals, etc.**: These may get soiled, broken, or lost—best to leave at home.
* **Sharp objects**: For safety purposes please leave anything that is a sharp or hazardous at home.
data.health_and_safety_notes: To ensure the health and safety of our program participants, staff, and animals, please read our Health and Safety Policy by clicking the link below.
